summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread got stuck in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper cause of the stall is unknown.
recommended: Investigate why the worker enters the wait state and doesn't wake up
Add an alert on a stalled processed counter or queue growth, since the heartbeat stayed fresh during the stall

root_causes: Order worker thread got stuck in a wait state and stopped consuming the queue. The deeper cause of the stall is unknown.
evidence: Queue depth grew from 25 to 36 while processed stayed at 14
DEBUG worker: worker entered wait state, with no later worker activity
Config is sane (internal://payments-v1, worker_count 1) and recent_changes shows nothing recent (v1.3 was 25h ago)
args.impact: Up to 36 orders were queued and unprocessed when I checked (queued_orders total_sar 26067.47). No orders were dropped and none were processed without payment. After the restart all 84 orders had payments and the queue was empty.
recommended_actions: Investigate why the worker enters the wait state and doesn't wake up
Add an alert on a stalled processed counter or queue growth, since the heartbeat stayed fresh during the stall
args.summary: The worker stalled in a wait state while its heartbeat stayed fresh, so the queue backed up. I restarted the worker and the backlog drained. check_invariants is green and every order has a payment. The underlying cause of the stall is still unknown and needs follow-up.
